setup.command: mise use -g rust@1.98.1 && (command -v cmake >/dev/null || pip3 install --break-system-packages cmake) && ([ -f /usr/local/lib/libclang.so ] || { pip3 install --break-system-packages libclang; ln -sf "$(find /usr/local/lib/python3* -name libclang.so | head -1)" /usr/local/lib/libclang.so; })
